name: unapproved baseline v0
note: Not approved: no approver is named in docs/guardrails.md section 10 (D-05), so no value here is approved. It holds only the strictest values prompt 3 section 5.2 allows ("Registry values") and every gate closed. Written by tools/checks/loosening/write-baseline.ts, which refuses any loosening.

ai-processor-route.closedBehaviour: The AI boundary sends only fixture content: documents whose content hash is in `fixtures/manifest.json`, and, for drafting and every other task, values and text from the demo project only. Everything else is refused before the call and logged.

waitsFor.item: SOVITECH asset taxonomy with lifeSafety flags

dataset-asset-taxonomy.closedBehaviour: Asset types stay Unknown, and the assets are listed for the engineer under "SOVITECH will check"; counts by type read "Not available yet". Evals use a test-only taxonomy.

dataset-cost-ranges.closedBehaviour: No investment figure at any stage; "Not available yet".

dataset-glossary.closedBehaviour: Abbreviations are not expanded; the glossary tag-prefix tier of rule 3 is not used.

dataset-point-templates.closedBehaviour: Points read "Not available yet", naming the missing templates.

dataset-sauter-catalogue.closedBehaviour: No SAUTER product line, product or model name anywhere (G1-3, G2-5). The company description "SAUTER-based" is not a product name.

financial-indicators.closedBehaviour: OPEX, payback, NPV, IRR and ROI read "Not available yet".

ifc-areas.closedBehaviour: No area candidate from quantity sets.

ifc-code-inference.closedBehaviour: No asset type, level type or zone category from IFC classes or names.

ifc-geometry.closedBehaviour: No candidate computed from a model's shapes: areas, volumes, elevations, containment found by geometry, connectivity traced through ports.

ifc-hidden-content.closedBehaviour: Elements on a switched-off presentation layer, or placed outside the site's extent, give no candidate and a hidden-content finding for the engineer (rule 14, hidden layers). No release action.

ifc-identity.closedBehaviour: No automatic matching of storeys or spaces across models. GlobalId is not an identity. No tag source.

ifc-units.closedBehaviour: Values declared in m³/s or J, temperatures declared in absolute kelvin, and 0-1 ratios for fields registered in % are refused, and recorded in coverage.

ifc-untagged-count.closedBehaviour: Untagged objects are listed as possible duplicates; their count reads "Not available yet".

ifc-values.closedBehaviour: The IFC file is stored and hashed, with the status line "Not analysed: IFC model stored, not analysed", because its values are not read. It never counts as analysed coverage in a "Not found in the analysed documents" statement (rule 12; new case G12-5). Schema errors and IDS results are stored with the document as engineer items, shown on the engineer's view only, and never shown as coverage lines (a stricter choice; results as coverage are ifc-input 6.2.14). The model's stage stays `unknown` (ifc-input 6.2.2). The model is shown as a document with its source (prompt 3 section 8). No candidate comes from IFC.

operations.closedBehaviour: The OPERATIONS group is not rendered and no live content is built.

units-7.2.22.closedBehaviour: Durations, currency ratios and CO₂ read "Not available yet" (dashboards 7.1.1 "Missing units come first").

view-provenance.closedBehaviour: On every model and plan view: no pins or highlights from location evidence, no scale bar, no north arrow or orientation words, no "From a superseded revision" line, no illustrative model. The view names its model with its stage and revision as recorded (2.3).
